newsitem.title: USA: Clinton declares disaster area in upstate New York.
newsitem.headline: Clinton declares disaster area in upstate New York.

text.p: President Clinton Monday declared six counties in upstate New York major disaster areas because of damage caused by severe thunderstorms and flooding last month.
The president's action, which makes federal disaster assistance available for victims, included Clinton, Essex, Fulton, Montgomery, Schuyler and Steuben counties.

Clinton also took steps to aid local governments to repair damaged public facilities. In addition to the six counties declared disaster areas, the decision also aids Chemung, Delaware, Lewis, Schoharie and Tompkins counties.
